patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Lusha and Outreach share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Frame: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Lusha and Outreach share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.. Choose Lusha only if your buying job matches “B2B data intelligence platform for verified contact/company data, enrichment, signals, and” rather than Outreach's shape. Choose Outreach only if your buying job matches “Enterprise sales engagement / AI revenue platform — Amplify Essentials/Core/Plus/Pro packa” rather than Lusha's shape. Workflow advantage: Lusha leans contact-management; Outreach leans sales-engagement, lead-management. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Lusha and Outreach share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: Lusha is B2B data intelligence platform for verified contact/company data, enrichment, signals, and Engage outreach sequences.; Outreach is Enterprise sales engagement / AI revenue platform — Amplify Essentials/Core/Plus/Pro packages; request pricing (seat + AI credits)..
- Workflow coverage skew: Lusha-leaning contact-management vs Outreach-leaning sales-engagement, lead-management.
- Researched limits: Lusha — Not a full CRM pipeline/deal system — buyers still need a CRM of record for pipeline hygiene.; Outreach — Not a contact database peer — weak as SI data/enrichment core.

Limitations — Lusha: Not a full CRM pipeline/deal system — buyers still need a CRM of record for pipeline hygiene.; Credit-based consumption for reveals/signals/API; unused annual credits do not roll over.; Outreach: Not a contact database peer — weak as SI data/enrichment core; No published dollar pricing — enterprise quote only.

Poor-fit cases: Lusha is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Not a full CRM pipeline/deal system — buyers still need a CRM of record for pipeline hygiene. · Outreach is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Not a contact database peer — weak as SI data/enrichment core · Avoid Lusha if you actually need Outreach's motion (Enterprise sales engagement / AI revenue platform — Amplify Essentials/Core/Plus)

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
